features: THE ENTRY THAT WAS THERE AND COULDN'T BE SEEN — No migration, no change to the calculation engine, no new feature: the database is left untouched. Two independent defects, held together only by having surfaced while looking at the same place. The first came from a forum report; the second we found while verifying the first, and it affects far more people.

AN EXPENSE ENTRY THAT EXISTED, COULDN'T BE SEEN, AND COULDN'T BE DELETED. The chart of accounts is designed around two levels: the chapter groups, the sub-account carries the amount and the millesimal table. Creating a third has been forbidden since beta.16, but up to 1.9.1 the «parent chapter» menu listed every entry with a zero amount — and a sub-account with no budget yet has a zero amount: it appeared there indistinguishable from a real chapter, and picking it created a third level in two clicks. Nobody who did it forced anything.

FROM THAT MOMENT THE ENTRY WAS A DEAD END. It existed in the database, but the on-screen tree stopped at the second level: it stayed selectable as a parent, invisible in the list, and it blocked deletion of the chapter containing it with a message about sub-accounts that could not be found. Getting out required seeing it. Now it is visible, indented under its parent, with an amber marker explaining what to do: it can be opened, moved under a first-level chapter, or deleted.

THE ERROR MESSAGE NO LONGER BLAMES A CHOICE NOBODY MADE. Saving a third-level entry, the software said «the selected parent is a sub-account» — but the administrator had selected nothing: that parent was already there. And the guidance card at the top of the page no longer promises «Ledger, Account and Sub-account» — three levels — on the very page where two have been allowed for a month.

WHAT THIS RELEASE DOES NOT FIX, AND SAYS SO. While an entry sits at the third level, an instalment plan generated including all entries does not charge it: the branch is funded at € 0.00, with no error and no warning. The fix was written and covered by tests, but two rounds of review showed that touching how the instalment plan chooses what to fund opened new defects each time on healthy installations — the ones that never had a third level. Between risking the allocation of people who have nothing to do with it, and leaving a defect that is now visible, flagged and diagnosable, we chose the second. The remedy is to flatten the structure, and the software now says how.

A COMMAND TO FIND OUT WHETHER IT CONCERNS YOU. `php artisan kondomanager:verifica-struttura-conti` lists entries beyond the second level, with the branch they sit in, and entries an instalment plan has frozen at € 0.00 despite having a budget underneath. It tells the pathological zero from the legitimate one — a genuinely empty chapter, or an entry emptied with «move expense», do not appear. It is read-only.

RECALCULATION NO LONGER CLAIMS SUCCESS WHEN IT DID NOTHING. The automatic sync of uncovered entries only reaches first-level chapters: on a sub-account it included nothing and still answered «instalment plan recalculated successfully». A confirmation that lies is worse than a defect that stays silent.

THE MEETING DOCUMENT THAT LOST A WHOLE OWNER. This has nothing to do with three levels and affects anyone with a usufruct, even with a perfect chart of accounts. On a unit held in bare ownership, with a usufructuary and no active «owner», and with the cost allocated to the owner, the engine resolves the role cascade and charges the bare owner. The «Allocation by chapter» PDF skipped them instead: the cascade was written with a condition that excluded it precisely for the owner — exactly that case.

THE OWNER VANISHED FROM THE DOCUMENT and the column total no longer matched the grand total, on the same sheet taken to the meeting: in the test, € 400.00 against € 1,000.00 actually charged. Beta.49 had fixed the same defect in the twin «Allocation by table» print and left this one behind — one of the two was fixed, and the test guarding consistency looked only at that one. Both now use the same rule as the engine.

Under the hood: the «Budget» total on the chart of accounts page now includes entries beyond the second level, which it previously excluded. Eleven new tests, each also verified in reverse — putting the previous code back must turn them red.
